task: put the bowl on top of the cabinet

windows.text: Reach the open gripper over the table toward the bowl.
Approach the bowl from above, lowering the open gripper toward its rim.
Grasp the bowl from above, closing the gripper fingers around its rim on the table.
Grasp the bowl on the table by closing the gripper fingers around its rim.
Lift the bowl up off the table, raising it beside the dark cabinet.
Lift the bowl up off the table, raising it above the bottle and stove.
Carry the bowl horizontally over the table toward the dark cabinet.
Lower the bowl down onto the top surface of the dark cabinet.
Release the bowl onto the top of the cabinet and open the gripper.
